about_the_game:
Hot Topics
Who doesn't want to have an exciting relationship with a beautiful coworker in the office? Opening a desk, from the most junior intern all the way back, promotion! Salary increase! Hold a beautiful woman! As long as the player wants, everything can be realized!

Beautiful Colleagues
Young girl, neighboring sister, iceberg beauty, charming royal sister, arrogant Qianjin, one time to participate in the different life of five beautiful women. Athlete, childhood friendship, happy enemies, play, a time to feel five different love experience.

Multi-branch plot ending
Each of the five heroines has an independent story line, with up to 14 different endings. Each heroine has a secret waiting to be discovered by the player, and the player can participate in their lives and dominate their destinies.

Versatile gameplay
The collection system and various QTE gameplay make the game full of fun. Collecting important items and clues will open up unexpected storylines, and a variety of QTE gameplay and mini-game mechanics bring a rich gameplay experience, allowing players to win the heart of the heroine with their strength.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains sensitive contents such as partial nudity or sexual content, as well as alcohol use, may not be suitable for all age ranges.
